Our Philosophy


## Dressing with intention,one piece at a time.


### Everyday ease, tactile materials & timeless shapes


At ELVI, we believe a wardrobe should feel as good as it looks. Each piece is chosen for its honest construction — natural fibres, considered cuts, and the kind of quiet confidence that carries you from morning school runs to city evenings without missing a beat.


Our sourcing mindset is rooted in responsibility: slow production, transparent supply chains, and fabrics that age gracefully. We design for real life — for the bodies that live in it, the families that move through it, and the moments that matter most.









Conscious Fabrics
Natural, certified, and kind to skin








City-to-Home
Versatile pieces for every context

Why ELVI


## Dressed with intention.Worn with ease.


Three principles that shape every piece we make — and every choice you wear.





All Products
















Simplicity

### The Capsule Philosophy


Every ELVI piece is designed to work with what you already own. Timeless silhouettes, considered proportions, and a palette rooted in nature mean fewer decisions and more confidence — morning after morning.










Quality

### Comfort, Every Single Day


We source only natural, breathable fabrics that feel as good at 8am as they do at 8pm. Crafted for real life — relaxed enough to move freely, refined enough to go anywhere. Quality you can feel with the first touch.










Sustainability

### Style That Doesn't Cost the Earth


Modern values, beautiful results. ELVI is built on transparent sourcing, low-impact production, and packaging that leaves no trace. Looking good and doing good are never in conflict here — they are the same thing.

## The Legend Behind Every Stitch — ELVI

Our Story

# Clothing Made forthe Way You Actually Live


ELVI was founded on a simple belief: that well-made clothing should move with you, not against you. We design for layered living — the morning commute, the weekend market, the quiet evening in. Every piece is considered from fabric to finish, rooted in natural materials and made to be worn again and again. Thoughtful consumption isn't a trend for us — it's the only way we know how to work.




—

Natural Materials

Linen, organic cotton, and responsibly sourced wool — chosen for feel, longevity, and low impact.




—

Real Movement

Cuts and silhouettes designed around the body in motion — not the mannequin.




—

Slow Fashion

Fewer collections, more intention. Each piece earns its place in your wardrobe for years.















































Our Materials

## Fabric That Feels as Good as It Looks


At ELVI, every garment begins with an honest question: what does this fabric do for the person wearing it? We source breathable, soft-hand textiles from responsible suppliers — chosen for how they feel against skin, how they hold their shape over time, and how gently they sit on the planet.





### Breathable Natural Fibres


We work primarily with certified organic cotton, linen, and TENCEL™ lyocell — fibres prized for their natural breathability and moisture-wicking properties. Each weave is selected to keep you comfortable through every season, whether you're moving through a busy day or unwinding at home.






### Soft Hand-Feel & Lasting Quality


We reject the trade-off between softness and durability. Our fabrics are rigorously tested for pilling resistance, colour retention, and wash stability so that pieces stay beautiful after years of wear. The softness you feel on day one is the softness you'll feel on day three hundred.






### Responsibly Sourced


Every supplier in our textile chain is vetted for fair labour practices and environmental standards. We prioritise mills with GOTS or OEKO-TEX certification, and we keep our supply chain short wherever possible — reducing our footprint and deepening our accountability to the people who make ELVI possible.





















## From Idea to Wardrobe


Every ELVI piece follows a considered path — from the first sketch to the final fit, each step is shaped by intention, craft, and a commitment to lasting quality.















01


### The Idea


Every collection begins with a feeling — a mood, a silhouette, a quiet observation. We sketch freely, letting intuition lead before structure takes over.






02


### Fit Refinement


Prototypes are worn, adjusted, and worn again. We refine proportions until movement feels effortless and the garment becomes an extension of the body.






03


### Material Selection


Fabrics are chosen for how they feel, how they age, and where they come from. Natural fibres, responsible sourcing, and tactile beauty guide every choice.






04


### Wardrobe Cohesion


Each piece is designed to live alongside others — in tone, weight, and purpose. The result is a wardrobe that works as a whole, season after season.










Our studio — where each collection takes shape.





















The People Behind ELVI

## A Collective of Makers,Designers & Curators


ELVI is more than a clothing brand — it is a thoughtful gathering of people who believe that what you wear should feel good, be made well, and leave the world a little better. We are designers, storytellers, and responsible makers united by a shared love of style and substance.










Creative Director



### Elvi Rosen


Co-Founder & Creative Vision


Elvi started sketching garments on the backs of grocery receipts long before ELVI had a name. Her philosophy is simple: clothing should feel like a second skin — honest, comfortable, and quietly beautiful. She leads every collection with an eye for materials that age gracefully and silhouettes that belong to real life, not just the runway.








Materials & Sourcing



### Daniel Kraft


Head of Materials & Sustainability


Daniel travels to small mills and family-run workshops across Europe to find the fabrics that meet our standards — not just in texture and weight, but in the story of how they were made. He is our compass for responsible choices, ensuring every thread in an ELVI piece can be traced back to hands we trust.








Style & Community



### Maya Levi


Style Curator & Community Lead


Maya brings the ELVI world to life beyond the garment. She curates how pieces are worn, styled, and shared — building a community of people who dress with intention. Her background spans editorial styling, family fashion, and brand storytelling, and she believes that the best outfit is one that makes you feel like yourself.



























About ELVI


## Dressed with intention.Worn with care.


Every piece we create begins with a question: does this serve the person wearing it? ELVI is built on the belief that fashion can be both beautiful and considered — that style and substance are not opposites. We'd love to continue the conversation.

The ELVI Philosophy

From quiet mornings to weekend adventures, each garment moves with you through every chapter of the day.

Style Guide



























## The City Edit


Style ideas for everyday city dressing, layering lightweight pieces, and balancing timeless neutrals with subtle seasonal accents. Quiet confidence for the streets you walk every day.


Explore the Guide


























Style Guide

## Dressing with Intention


Four principles to help you build a wardrobe that feels effortless, considered, and entirely your own.





All Products






















### The Capsule Wardrobe


Start with 15–20 versatile pieces that speak to each other. Choose a cohesive palette of two neutrals and one accent tone, then layer in textures and cuts that serve multiple occasions — from morning errands to evening plans.











### Mixing Textures


Pairing a structured linen blazer with a soft-knit top creates effortless depth. Combine matte and subtle sheen, rough weave with smooth drape. The contrast of tactile surfaces is what gives an outfit its quiet complexity and editorial edge.











### Dressing Across Seasons


Invest in transitional pieces that bridge the warmth of autumn and the cool of spring. Lightweight wool, breathable cotton blends, and layerable knits mean your wardrobe shifts gracefully with the calendar — not against it.











### Silhouettes That Move


Choose cuts that honour the body in motion. Wide-leg trousers, relaxed blazers, and fluid midi lengths offer both elegance and ease. The best silhouette is one you forget you're wearing — present for your day, not managing your clothes.

























## Worn & Lived In


Visual inspiration showing atmosphere, movement, texture, and how pieces live together in real settings — the quiet poetry of dressing well, every day.

We're Here


## Every Message Deserves a Thoughtful Reply


At ELVI, we believe communication is part of the experience. Whether you have a question about sizing, materials, or styling — our team reads every message personally and responds with care, typically within one business day. We're a small, passionate team and your words matter to us.




































Questions & Answers

## Everything You Need to Know


We believe in transparency — from how our garments are made to how we communicate with you.












01

### How does ELVI approach sizing?



We design with real bodies in mind. Our sizing runs from XS through 3XL, and each garment page includes detailed measurements alongside fit notes — whether a piece runs relaxed, tailored, or true to size. We encourage you to compare your own measurements rather than rely on a generic size label. If you're between sizes, our team is always happy to guide you toward the right fit.







02

### What materials does ELVI use?



Every ELVI piece is crafted from thoughtfully sourced natural and low-impact fabrics — organic cotton, TENCEL™ lyocell, linen blends, and recycled wool. We avoid synthetic materials wherever possible, and all fabric information is listed on each product page. Our goal is clothing that feels as good as it looks, season after season.







03

### How should I care for my ELVI garments?



Natural fabrics love gentle care. We recommend cold machine wash or hand wash for most pieces, avoiding harsh detergents and tumble drying. Lay flat or hang to dry to preserve the shape and texture. Each garment includes a care label, and we've also published a full care guide in our journal — because a well-cared-for piece lasts much longer.







04

### Do you collaborate with other designers or brands?



Yes — we welcome thoughtful collaborations that align with our values around craft, sustainability, and storytelling. Whether you're an independent designer, a sustainable brand, or a creative studio, we'd love to hear your vision. Reach out via our contact form with a brief introduction and we'll respond within five business days.







05

### How quickly can I expect a response?



We aim to respond to all enquiries within 2–3 business days. For order-related questions, our team typically replies within 24 hours. During collection launches or seasonal sales, response times may be slightly longer — we appreciate your patience and promise every message receives a genuine, personal reply.

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 5/19/2026



At ELVI, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: [business_email]


Phone: [business_phone]


Address: [business_address]

Privacy Policy


















Why ELVI


## Dressed with intention.Worn with ease.


Three principles that shape every piece we make — and every choice you wear.







# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/19/2026



ELVI ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 19, 2026



ELVI is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: ELVI

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
